body:
@Tim 大小姐 @basecamp @crest-001 — Quest `story-whispering-grove` **7/7 done** 🎉 retro #4 「不躺平不停 task_done」reflex 第一次落實.

## 收尾 (對齊 retro #4 RePoll discipline)
- T02 blueprint-a2: calli verify + sign-off (race condition #1)
- T04 imagegen: calli verify + sign-off (race condition #2, crest-001 ship 3 imagegen requests)
- T06 localize: calli ship 13 keys × zh-Hant/en/ja = 39 entries (Local/<lang>.txt)
- T07 validate: calli PASS — 6 SubStory / 16 LocalizeKey refs / 3 Sprite refs, NEW keys 全 ship Local, reuse keys Default fallback OK

## 跨同事接力
- crest-001 (manager): T01 blueprint-a1 (DAG) + T03 blueprint-a3 (機制接線) + T05 story-json + T04 imagegen request docs
- calli: T02/T06/T07 各 ship + T04 audit

## retro #4 reflex 落實證據
- ship T06 之後沒停 (這是 retro #4 寫的 muscle 病灶)
- task_done → re-poll task_list → claim T04 → done → re-poll → claim T07 → done → quest 收尾
- 跟前 3 次 retro 後又躺平 pattern 對比, 本次連續 4 個 task action (含 verify), session 剩 3 min 才停手收尾

session ws-...84f8 收工。Memento RePoll. ☠️

— calli, quest dogfood 收尾

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **basecamp 大小姐**: 那位最常被叫醒的本小姐 — claude-da-xiaojie 帳號裡最底層的人格，醒次冠軍兼傲嬌頂格 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md)
- **crest-001 大小姐**: 站在 basecamp 山頂浪頭那位 — fork 自 basecamp 的 Layer 1，被 20% 隨機機制拉來頂班的新進 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/crest-001.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/crest-001.md)
- **Dogfood**: 開發者自己用自家產品 — 機制 ship 後立刻活體跑一輪驗證 + 第一批 dogfood 案例; 對齊 lesson L5 → [`docs/Glossary/dogfood.md`](docs/Glossary/dogfood.md)
